review_scope.covariance_scope: Privacy acceptance uses the recorded outward Arb enclosures from the reviewed band-LDL/selected-inverse/Woodbury oracle. This review is not an independent numerical covariance replay or an independent interval-arithmetic implementation.
review_scope.exact_arithmetic: Independent rational arithmetic from the received semantic Q,p recomputes s_i,c_e, objective, allocation domain/caps, outward-bound comparisons, dual multiplier, every recorded affine coefficient, intersected constant interval, and global uniform-family box lower bound.
review_scope.hash_scope: Overlay, candidate, original case/method, intent, deadline, current extension source, and complete frozen manifest text were independently rehashed after readback. Archive SHA is bound by the collected status/package receipt and the parent-specified expected hash; this reviewer did not independently rehash binary archive bytes.
review_scope.mode: Read-only current-run result review. No optimizer, experiment, or numerical covariance replay was run.
review_scope.optimality_scope: The objective brackets concern the full UNIFORM family under the frozen caps; neither candidate is claimed exactly optimal, and these are not lower bounds for the unrestricted nonuniform pairwise family.
review_scope.source_review: The executed extension source hashes to the previously reviewed339f version. Reviewed common/solvers/uniform_oracle/runner/bounded_exec bytes match the frozen manifest and collected source map. Only privacy-certificate and global-lower-bound precision ceilings change from512 to4096.

workload_identity: Exact weighted query-row distribution: duplicates combined, zero weights removed, row ordering ignored; timing seeds/repeats alone do not define independent workloads.
